failure_summary.description: The agent made the requested attraction search but left the call bare and did not save its result to the cache.

patch.reasoning: The skill already requires saving every result-producing call, but the trajectory still omitted the save. A final code audit adds a procedural check that can catch this omission before the code is returned.

edits.content: - **Audit persistence before returning code:** Check that every search, filter, sort, and `search_nearest` call in the generated code is assigned to a variable and that the exact result is saved with `save_to_cache` before the code ends. This applies to initial searches as well as follow-up updates, even when only one tool call is needed.
